purpose: Measure natural reconstruction and complete downstream CE for all stage2 functional dictionaries and original seeds on the same validation tokens
scope: Natural quality on 256 original R19 validation sequences, with full-model reconstruction at every h11 position. Functional task outcomes are evaluated separately.
